 # NimbusSeat All-in-One Android APK
 
 Один APK, который содержит **всё**: лаунчер NimbusSeat (поиск хоста в LAN,
 6-часовой таймер, старт сессии) **плюс встроенный open-source Moonlight**
 ([moonlight-android](https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-android),
 GPL-3.0). Ничего не нужно скачивать из Play Market.
 
 ## Как собирается
 
 GitHub Actions (workflow `Android All-in-One APK`):
 1. клонирует moonlight-android v12.1 с сабмодулями (стриминговое ядро C);
 2. накладывает наш код из `overlay/` (лаунчер + discovery + REST-клиент);
 3. `patch_moonlight.py` меняет applicationId на `app.nimbusseat.client`
    (по просьбе автора Moonlight не выпускать чужие сборки под `com.limelight`),
    метку приложения на NimbusSeat и делает наш экран стартовым;
 4. собирает `assembleNonRootRelease` и подписывает **release-ключом**
    (keystore хранится в GitHub Secrets).
 
 ## Облачный экран: любая цель
 
 Экран «Облако» не зашит на один репозиторий. В ⚙ задаются `repo`, `token`,
 `workflow`, ветка и файл сессии, и `inputs` запуска в JSON — то есть один APK
 может подключаться и к NimbusSeat-Runner, и к экрану `zen-panel`, и к форку.
 Два пресета (NimbusSeat / zen-panel экран) переключают цель одним тапом.
 Понимаются оба формата сессии (`session.json` на `live`, `live/session-*.json`
 на `session-state`); адрес берётся из `url`/`novncUrl`/`novnc`/`web`.
 
+Подключение — через **предпросмотр**: «🔗 Предпросмотр» встраивает экран прямо
+в WebView (короткий бокс; тап по нему разворачивает на весь экран, «Назад» —
+свернуть), «⛶ На весь экран» открывает сразу развёрнутым, «↗ Ссылка в браузере»
+отдаёт адрес системе. Экран показывается, как только в сессии есть адрес, —
+даже если `state` не записан; пустой токен больше не мешает читать публичные
+репозитории (заголовок `Authorization` не шлётся, если токена нет).
+

 Итоговый APK — производная работа от moonlight-android → распространяется по
 **GPL-3.0**. Исходники изменений — в этой папке.

display.text:
"""Unit tests for the client target/session helpers (no network, no tkinter).

Covers the part that makes a client able to point at ANY repo/runner: URL
extraction from both session layouts, state normalization, and config
migration from the old single-seat file.
"""
import importlib.util
import sys
from pathlib import Path

MOD = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "clients" / "desktop" / "nimbus_targets.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nimbus_targets", MOD)
nt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules["nimbus_targets"] = nt
spec.loader.exec_module(nt)


def test_extract_url_prefers_url_then_novnc():
    assert nt.extract_url({"url": "https://a/x"}) == "https://a/x"
    assert nt.extract_url({"novncUrl": "https://b/vnc.html"}) == "https://b/vnc.html"
    assert nt.extract_url({"url": "about:blank", "web": "https://c"}) == "https://c"
    assert nt.extract_url({}) is None
    assert nt.extract_url(None) is None


def test_normalize_nimbus_seat_live():
    s = nt.normalize_session({"state": "live", "url": "https://host/nimbus.html?pw=x",
                              "resolution": "1280x720", "fps": 30})
    assert s["live"] is True
    assert s["url"] == "https://host/nimbus.html?pw=x"
    assert s["resolution"] == "1280x720"


def test_normalize_zen_panel_vnc_has_no_state_field():
    # zen-panel's VNC slot publishes url/novncUrl but no `state`.
    s = nt.normalize_session({"kind": "Linux-VNC", "os": "linux",
                              "url": "https://host/vnc.html",
                              "novncUrl": "https://host/vnc.html"})
    assert s["live"] is True
    assert s["kind"] == "Linux-VNC"
    assert s["url"] == "https://host/vnc.html"


def test_ended_is_never_live_even_with_stale_url():
    s = nt.normalize_session({"state": "ended", "url": "https://host/vnc.html"})
    assert s["live"] is False
    assert s["state"] == "ended"


def test_offline_without_url():
    assert nt.normalize_session({"state": "offline"})["live"] is False
    assert nt.normalize_session({})["live"] is False


def test_migrate_legacy_single_seat():
    cfg = nt.migrate_config({"repo": "me/fork", "token": "t"})
    assert cfg["token"] == "t"
    assert len(cfg["targets"]) == 1
    assert cfg["targets"][0]["repo"] == "me/fork"
    assert cfg["targets"][0]["session"]["branch"] == "live"
    assert cfg["active"] == cfg["targets"][0]["name"]


def test_migrate_empty_uses_defaults():
    cfg = nt.migrate_config({})
    names = [t["name"] for t in cfg["targets"]]
    assert "NimbusSeat" in names and "zen-panel screen" in names
    assert cfg["active"] == names[0]


def test_migrate_keeps_existing_targets_and_fixes_active():
    raw = {"token": "t", "active": "nope", "targets": [
        {"name": "A", "repo": "o/a"}, {"name": "B", "repo": "o/b"}]}
    cfg = nt.migrate_config(raw)
    assert [t["name"] for t in cfg["targets"]] == ["A", "B"]
    assert cfg["active"] == "A"          # bad active falls back to the first
    assert cfg["targets"][0]["workflow"] == nt.NIMBUS_WORKFLOW


def test_find_target():
    cfg = nt.migrate_config({"targets": [{"name": "A", "repo": "o/a"},
                                         {"name": "B", "repo": "o/b"}], "active": "B"})
    assert nt.find_target(cfg)["name"] == "B"
    assert nt.find_target(cfg, "A")["name"] == "A"
    assert nt.find_target({"targets": []}) is None

display.text:
name: Android All-in-One APK
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "clients/android-allinone/**"
      - ".github/workflows/android-allinone.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Clone moonlight-android (GPL-3.0) with submodules
        run: |
          git clone --branch v12.1 --depth 1 --recurse-submodules --shallow-submodules \
            https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-android.git /tmp/moonlight

      - name: Overlay NimbusSeat launcher sources
        run: |
          cp -r clients/android-allinone/overlay/java/* /tmp/moonlight/app/src/main/java/
          python3 clients/android-allinone/patch_moonlight.py /tmp/moonlight

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3

      - name: Decode release keystore
        run: echo "${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_B64 }}" | base64 -d > /tmp/nimbus.keystore

      - name: Build signed release APK
        working-directory: /tmp/moonlight
        env:
          NIMBUS_KEYSTORE: /tmp/nimbus.keystore
          NIMBUS_STOREPASS: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          NIMBUS_KEYALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: ./gradlew assembleNonRootRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace

      - name: Collect APK
        run: |
          apk=$(find /tmp/moonlight/app/build/outputs/apk -name "*.apk" | head -1)
          echo "found: $apk"
          cp "$apk" /tmp/NimbusSeat-allinone-release.apk

      - name: Upload APK artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: NimbusSeat-allinone-release-apk
          path: /tmp/NimbusSeat-allinone-release.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

 # NimbusSeat All-in-One Android APK
 
 Один APK, который содержит **всё**: лаунчер NimbusSeat (поиск хоста в LAN,
 6-часовой таймер, старт сессии) **плюс встроенный open-source Moonlight**
 ([moonlight-android](https://github.com/moonlight-stream/moonlight-android),
 GPL-3.0). Ничего не нужно скачивать из Play Market.
 
 ## Как собирается
 
 GitHub Actions (workflow `Android All-in-One APK`):
 1. клонирует moonlight-android v12.1 с сабмодулями (стриминговое ядро C);
 2. накладывает наш код из `overlay/` (лаунчер + discovery + REST-клиент);
 3. `patch_moonlight.py` меняет applicationId на `app.nimbusseat.client`
    (по просьбе автора Moonlight не выпускать чужие сборки под `com.limelight`),
    метку приложения на NimbusSeat и делает наш экран стартовым;
 4. собирает `assembleNonRootRelease` и подписывает **release-ключом**
    (keystore хранится в GitHub Secrets).
 
 ## Облачный экран: любая цель
 
 Экран «Облако» не зашит на один репозиторий. В ⚙ задаются `repo`, `token`,
 `workflow`, ветка и файл сессии, и `inputs` запуска в JSON — то есть один APK
 может подключаться и к NimbusSeat-Runner, и к экрану `zen-panel`, и к форку.
 Два пресета (NimbusSeat / zen-panel экран) переключают цель одним тапом.
 Понимаются оба формата сессии (`session.json` на `live`, `live/session-*.json`
 на `session-state`); адрес берётся из `url`/`novncUrl`/`novnc`/`web`.
 
 Подключение — через **предпросмотр**: «🔗 Предпросмотр» встраивает экран прямо
 в WebView (короткий бокс; тап по нему разворачивает на весь экран, «Назад» —
 свернуть), «⛶ На весь экран» открывает сразу развёрнутым, «↗ Ссылка в браузере»
 отдаёт адрес системе. Экран показывается, как только в сессии есть адрес, —
 даже если `state` не записан; пустой токен больше не мешает читать публичные
-репозитории (заголовок `Authorization` не шлётся, если токена нет).

+`vnc.html` от noVNC дополняется `?autoconnect=1&resize=scale` — иначе видна
+тёмная табличка «Connect» и рабочий стол 1:1 (на телефоне выглядит как чёрный
+экран).
 
 ## Лицензия
 
 Итоговый APK — производная работа от moonlight-android → распространяется по
 **GPL-3.0**. Исходники изменений — в этой папке.

 #!/usr/bin/env python3
 """Targets and session-schema helpers for the NimbusSeat clients.
 
 A "target" is one remote seat: a GitHub repo, the workflow that launches it,
 the dispatch inputs, and where its live session descriptor lives. Keeping that
 as data - instead of a hardcoded repo/workflow/branch - is what lets one client
 hang off ANY repo and runner: its own NimbusSeat-Runner, a `zen-panel` screen,
 a fork, a mirror.
 
 Only the standard library is used, and nothing here imports tkinter, so the
 module can be unit-tested on a headless runner and reused by CLI tools.
 
 Two session layouts are understood, without any per-repo wiring:
 
   * NimbusSeat   -> branch ``live``            file ``session.json``
                     {state: live|offline, url: <nimbus.html?...>}
   * zen-panel    -> branch ``session-state``   file ``live/session-vnc.json``
                     {kind: Linux-VNC, url: <.../vnc.html>, novncUrl: ...}
 
 Anything that carries a browser URL is accepted; the state falls back to
 "live when a URL is present" so a publisher that never writes ``state`` (like
 zen-panel's VNC slot) still shows up.
 """
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import base64
 import json
 import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
 import urllib.request
 from pathlib import Path
 
 GH = "https://api.github.com"
 
 NIMBUS_WORKFLOW = "remote-seat.yml"
 
+# noVNC page names that stop on a "Connect" dialog (a dark screen the user reads
+# as "black") and render the remote 1:1 unless told to fit. See novnc_url().
+NOVNC_PAGES = ("vnc.html", "vnc_lite.html")
+
 # Keys a session descriptor may use for the address the client should open, in
 # preference order. Both "novncUrl" (zen-panel) and "novnc" (NimbusSeat) are
 # covered, plus a plain "url"/"web"/"desktop" from any future publisher.
 URL_KEYS = ("url", "novncUrl", "novnc", "web", "desktop", "hubUrl")
 
 # Two built-in targets so a fresh install can pick either without typing
 # anything. Only repo/token are tied to an account; editing the name/token in
 # the UI (or MIGRATION.md) moves the whole thing to a new mirror.
 DEFAULT_TARGETS = [
     {
         "name": "NimbusSeat",
         "repo": "sj0404-collab/NimbusSeat-Runner",
         "workflow": NIMBUS_WORKFLOW,
         "inputs": {"minutes": "340", "resolution": "1280x720", "fps": "30"},
         "session": {"branch": "live", "path": "session.json"},
     },
     {
         "name": "zen-panel screen",
         "repo": "sj0404-collab/zen-panel",
         "workflow": "hub.yml",
         "inputs": {"os": "linux", "label": "panel"},
         "session": {"branch": "session-state", "path": "live/session-vnc.json"},
     },
 ]
 
 
 def extract_url(data) -> str | None:
     """First http(s) address a session descriptor advertises, or None."""
     if not isinstance(data, dict):
         return None
     for key in URL_KEYS:
         value = data.get(key)
         if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
             return value
     return None
 
 
+def novnc_url(url: str | None) -> str | None:
+    """Make an unconfigured noVNC page actually show the screen.
+
+    A bare ``vnc.html`` stops on a "Connect" dialog (a dark screen users read as
+    "black") and renders the remote at 1:1 - on a phone that is one dark corner.
+    For a noVNC page with no query of its own we add ``autoconnect=1`` and
+    ``resize=scale`` so it connects at once and fits the viewport. Any existing
+    query (e.g. a password or a custom path) is left untouched.
+    """
+    if not url:
+        return url
+    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
+    if not parts.path.endswith(NOVNC_PAGES):
+        return url
+    params = dict(urllib.parse.parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True))
+    params.setdefault("autoconnect", "1")
+    params.setdefault("resize", "scale")
+    return urllib.parse.urlunsplit(
+        parts._replace(query=urllib.parse.urlencode(params))
+    )
+
+
 def normalize_session(data) -> dict:
     """Flatten any supported session descriptor into one stable shape.
 
     ``live`` is the only field callers must trust; the rest are best-effort.
     A descriptor with an explicit non-"live" state (e.g. zen-panel's "ended")
     is never treated as live even if a stale URL is still present.
     """
     if not isinstance(data, dict):
         return {"live": False, "state": "offline", "url": None, "raw": {}}
     url = extract_url(data)
     state = data.get("state")
     if not state:
         state = "live" if url else "offline"
     return {
         "live": state == "live" and bool(url),
         "state": str(state),
         "url": url,
         "novnc": data.get("novncUrl") or data.get("novnc") or data.get("web") or url,
         "kind": data.get("kind") or data.get("type") or "",
         "label": data.get("label") or "",
         "resolution": data.get("resolution") or "",
         "fps": data.get("fps"),
         "ends_at_utc": data.get("ends_at_utc") or data.get("endsAtUtc") or "",
         "password": data.get("password") or "",
         "raw": data,
     }
 
 
 def _normalize_target(target: dict) -> dict:
     target = dict(target or {})
     target.setdefault("name", target.get("repo", "seat"))
     target.setdefault("repo", "")
     target.setdefault("workflow", NIMBUS_WORKFLOW)
     target.setdefault("token", "")
     inputs = target.get("inputs")
     target["inputs"] = dict(inputs) if isinstance(inputs, dict) else {}
     session = target.get("session")
     if not isinstance(session, dict):
         session = {}
     session.setdefault("branch", "live")
     session.setdefault("path", "session.json")
     target["session"] = session
     return target
 
 
 def migrate_config(raw) -> dict:
     """Upgrade every config shape to {"token", "targets": [...], "active"}.
 
     Accepts the legacy {"repo", "token"} single-seat file, the current
     {"targets": [...], "active", "token"} file, and an empty/missing file
     (falls back to the built-in targets).
     """
     raw = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
     token = raw.get("token", "") or ""
 
     if isinstance(raw.get("targets"), list) and raw["targets"]:
         targets = [_normalize_target(t) for t in raw["targets"]]
     elif raw.get("repo"):
         legacy = dict(DEFAULT_TARGETS[0])
         legacy["repo"] = raw["repo"]
         if raw.get("workflow"):
             legacy["workflow"] = raw["workflow"]
         if isinstance(raw.get("session"), dict):
             legacy["session"] = raw["session"]
         targets = [_normalize_target(legacy)]
     else:
         targets = [_normalize_target(dict(t)) for t in DEFAULT_TARGETS]
 
     names = [t["name"] for t in targets]
     active = raw.get("active")
     if active not in names:
         active = names[0] if names else ""
     return {"token": token, "targets": targets, "active": active}
 
 
 def load_config(path: Path | str) -> dict:
     path = Path(path)
     if path.is_file():
         try:
             return migrate_config(json.loads(path.read_text()))
         except (ValueError, OSError):
             pass
     return migrate_config({})
 
 
 def save_config(path: Path | str, config: dict) -> None:
     Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(config, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
 
 
 def find_target(config: dict, name: str | None = None) -> dict | None:
     targets = config.get("targets") or []
     if not targets:
         return None
     wanted = name or config.get("active")
     for target in targets:
         if target.get("name") == wanted:
             return target
     return targets[0]
 
 
 class GitHub:
     """Tiny GitHub Actions/contents client for one token (stdlib only)."""
 
     def __init__(self, token: str):
         self.token = token or ""
 
     def _req(self, method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None):
         # Public repos must read fine with no token: GitHub answers 401 to a
         # bare `Authorization: token ` header, so only send it when present.
         headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"}
         if self.token:
             headers["Authorization"] = f"token {self.token}"
         req = urllib.request.Request(
             GH + path,
             method=method,
             data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,
             headers=headers,
         )
         try:
             with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
                 raw = resp.read()
                 return resp.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
         except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
             return exc.code, {}
         except OSError:
             return 0, {}
 
     def read_session(self, target: dict) -> dict | None:
         session = target.get("session") or {}
         branch = session.get("branch", "live")
         path = session.get("path", "session.json")
         code, data = self._req(
             "GET", f"/repos/{target['repo']}/contents/{path}?ref={branch}"
         )
         if code != 200 or "content" not in data:
             return None
         try:
             payload = json.loads(base64.b64decode(data["content"]))
         except (ValueError, KeyError):
             return None
         return normalize_session(payload)
 
     def dispatch(self, target: dict, ref: str = "main",
                  overrides: dict | None = None) -> bool:
         inputs = dict(target.get("inputs") or {})
         if overrides:
             for key, value in overrides.items():
                 if key in inputs:
                     inputs[key] = value
         code, _ = self._req(
             "POST",
             f"/repos/{target['repo']}/actions/workflows/{target['workflow']}"
             f"/dispatches",
             {"ref": ref, "inputs": inputs},
         )
         return code == 204
 
     def cancel(self, target: dict) -> int:
         """Cancel active runs of the target's workflow; returns how many."""
         workflow = target.get("workflow", "")
         code, data = self._req(
             "GET", f"/repos/{target['repo']}/actions/runs?per_page=20"
         )
         if code != 200:
             return 0
         cancelled = 0
         for run in data.get("workflow_runs", []):
             if run.get("status") not in ("queued", "in_progress"):
                 continue
             run_path = run.get("path", "")
             if workflow and not run_path.endswith("/" + workflow):
                 continue
             self._req(
                 "POST", f"/repos/{target['repo']}/actions/runs/{run['id']}/cancel"
             )
             cancelled += 1
         return cancelled

 """Unit tests for the client target/session helpers (no network, no tkinter).
 
 Covers the part that makes a client able to point at ANY repo/runner: URL
 extraction from both session layouts, state normalization, and config
 migration from the old single-seat file.
 """
 import importlib.util
 import sys
 from pathlib import Path
 
 MOD = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "clients" / "desktop" / "nimbus_targets.py"
 spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nimbus_targets", MOD)
 nt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
 sys.modules["nimbus_targets"] = nt
 spec.loader.exec_module(nt)
 
 
 def test_extract_url_prefers_url_then_novnc():
     assert nt.extract_url({"url": "https://a/x"}) == "https://a/x"
     assert nt.extract_url({"novncUrl": "https://b/vnc.html"}) == "https://b/vnc.html"
     assert nt.extract_url({"url": "about:blank", "web": "https://c"}) == "https://c"
     assert nt.extract_url({}) is None
     assert nt.extract_url(None) is None
 
 
 def test_normalize_nimbus_seat_live():
     s = nt.normalize_session({"state": "live", "url": "https://host/nimbus.html?pw=x",
                               "resolution": "1280x720", "fps": 30})
     assert s["live"] is True
     assert s["url"] == "https://host/nimbus.html?pw=x"
     assert s["resolution"] == "1280x720"
 
 
 def test_normalize_zen_panel_vnc_has_no_state_field():
     # zen-panel's VNC slot publishes url/novncUrl but no `state`.
     s = nt.normalize_session({"kind": "Linux-VNC", "os": "linux",
                               "url": "https://host/vnc.html",
                               "novncUrl": "https://host/vnc.html"})
     assert s["live"] is True
     assert s["kind"] == "Linux-VNC"
     assert s["url"] == "https://host/vnc.html"
 
 
 def test_ended_is_never_live_even_with_stale_url():
     s = nt.normalize_session({"state": "ended", "url": "https://host/vnc.html"})
     assert s["live"] is False
     assert s["state"] == "ended"
 
 
 def test_offline_without_url():
     assert nt.normalize_session({"state": "offline"})["live"] is False
     assert nt.normalize_session({})["live"] is False
 
 
 def test_migrate_legacy_single_seat():
     cfg = nt.migrate_config({"repo": "me/fork", "token": "t"})
     assert cfg["token"] == "t"
     assert len(cfg["targets"]) == 1
     assert cfg["targets"][0]["repo"] == "me/fork"
     assert cfg["targets"][0]["session"]["branch"] == "live"
     assert cfg["active"] == cfg["targets"][0]["name"]
 
 
 def test_migrate_empty_uses_defaults():
     cfg = nt.migrate_config({})
     names = [t["name"] for t in cfg["targets"]]
     assert "NimbusSeat" in names and "zen-panel screen" in names
     assert cfg["active"] == names[0]

     raw = {"token": "t", "active": "nope", "targets": [

"""Targets and session-schema helpers for the NimbusSeat clients.

A "target" is one remote seat: a GitHub repo, the workflow that launches it,
the dispatch inputs, and where its live session descriptor lives. Keeping that
as data - instead of a hardcoded repo/workflow/branch - is what lets one client

a fork, a mirror.

Only the standard library is used, and nothing here imports tkinter, so the
module can be unit-tested on a headless runner and reused by CLI tools.

  * NimbusSeat   -> branch ``live``            file ``session.json``

# Two built-in targets so a fresh install can pick either without typing
# anything. Only repo/token are tied to an account; editing the name/token in
# the UI (or MIGRATION.md) moves the whole thing to a new mirror.
DEFAULT_TARGETS = [
    {
        "name": "NimbusSeat",
        "repo": "sj0404-collab/NimbusSeat-Runner",
        "workflow": NIMBUS_WORKFLOW,
        "inputs": {"minutes": "340", "resolution": "1280x720", "fps": "30"},
        "session": {"branch": "live", "path": "session.json"},
    },
    {
        "name": "zen-panel screen",
        "repo": "sj0404-collab/zen-panel",
        "workflow": "hub.yml",
        "inputs": {"os": "linux", "label": "panel"},
        "session": {"branch": "session-state", "path": "live/session-vnc.json"},
    },
]


def extract_url(data) -> str | None:
    """First http(s) address a session descriptor advertises, or None."""
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return None
    for key in URL_KEYS:
        value = data.get(key)
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            return value
    return None


def normalize_session(data) -> dict:
    """Flatten any supported session descriptor into one stable shape.

    ``live`` is the only field callers must trust; the rest are best-effort.
    A descriptor with an explicit non-"live" state (e.g. zen-panel's "ended")
    is never treated as live even if a stale URL is still present.
    """
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return {"live": False, "state": "offline", "url": None, "raw": {}}
    url = extract_url(data)
    state = data.get("state")
    if not state:
        state = "live" if url else "offline"
    return {
        "live": state == "live" and bool(url),
        "state": str(state),
        "url": url,
        "novnc": data.get("novncUrl") or data.get("novnc") or data.get("web") or url,
        "kind": data.get("kind") or data.get("type") or "",
        "label": data.get("label") or "",
        "resolution": data.get("resolution") or "",
        "fps": data.get("fps"),
        "ends_at_utc": data.get("ends_at_utc") or data.get("endsAtUtc") or "",
        "password": data.get("password") or "",
        "raw": data,
    }

def test_empty_token_sends_no_authorization(monkeypatch):
    # A bare `Authorization: token ` makes GitHub 401 even on public repos,
    # so a tokenless client must not send the header at all.
    assert _capture_auth(monkeypatch, "") is None


def test_token_is_sent_when_present(monkeypatch):
    assert _capture_auth(monkeypatch, "abc") == "token abc"


def test_novnc_url_adds_autoconnect_and_scale():
    # zen-panel publishes a bare vnc.html: without this it shows a dark
    # Connect dialog at 1:1 instead of the desktop.
    assert nt.novnc_url("https://h/vnc.html") == \
        "https://h/vnc.html?autoconnect=1&resize=scale"
    assert nt.novnc_url("https://h/path/vnc_lite.html") == \
        "https://h/path/vnc_lite.html?autoconnect=1&resize=scale"


def test_novnc_url_keeps_existing_query():
    out = nt.novnc_url("https://h/vnc.html?password=secret")
    assert "password=secret" in out
    assert "autoconnect=1" in out and "resize=scale" in out


def test_novnc_url_leaves_non_novnc_untouched():
    assert nt.novnc_url("https://h/nimbus.html?pw=x") == "https://h/nimbus.html?pw=x"
    assert nt.novnc_url(None) is None

   * Local  — LAN-хост (Duo/Moonlight): автопоиск, 6-часовой таймер, Play.
   * Cloud  — облачное место на GitHub-раннере: список целей (targets), запуск

 хранятся в nimbus_cloud.json и переключаются прямо в UI, поэтому один клиент
 может смотреть и на NimbusSeat-Runner, и на экран zen-panel, и на любой форк,
 не будучи жёстко привязанным к одному репозиторию. Логика целей и форматов

 import urllib.request

 from pathlib import Path
 from tkinter import messagebox, ttk

 DISCOVERY_PORT = 48121
 MAGIC = b"NIMBUSSEAT/1"

 # ----------------------------- LAN part -----------------------------------
 
 def discover(timeout: float = 3.0):
     sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
     sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_BROADCAST, 1)
     sock.settimeout(timeout)
     try:
         sock.sendto(MAGIC, ("255.255.255.255", DISCOVERY_PORT))
         data, addr = sock.recvfrom(1024)
         info = json.loads(data.decode())
         if info.get("magic") == "NIMBUSSEAT/1":
             return addr[0], info
     except OSError:
         pass
     finally:
         sock.close()
     return None
 
 
 def api(host_ip, port, path, method="GET"):
     req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://{host_ip}:{port}/api/v1/{path}", method=method)
     with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
         return json.loads(resp.read().decode())

def novnc_url(url: str | None, gate: str = "") -> str | None:
    """Decorate an address so it really shows the seat.

    Two things get fixed here, both learned the hard way:

    * A bare noVNC page (``vnc.html``) stops on a dark "Connect" dialog and

    def _target(self):
        return nt.find_target(self.cloud.config, self.pick.get())

    def load(self):
        t = self._target() or {}
        session = t.get("session") or {}
        self.v_name.set(t.get("name", ""))
        self.v_repo.set(t.get("repo", ""))
        self.v_workflow.set(t.get("workflow", nt.NIMBUS_WORKFLOW))
        self.v_branch.set(session.get("branch", "live"))
        self.v_path.set(session.get("path", "session.json"))
        self.v_inputs.set(json.dumps(t.get("inputs") or {}, ensure_ascii=False))

    def save(self):
        try:
            inputs = json.loads(self.v_inputs.get() or "{}")
            assert isinstance(inputs, dict)
        except (ValueError, AssertionError):
            return messagebox.showerror("NimbusSeat", "inputs — должен быть JSON-объект", parent=self)
        target = {
            "name": self.v_name.get().strip() or self.v_repo.get().strip(),
            "repo": self.v_repo.get().strip(),
            "token": "",
            "workflow": self.v_workflow.get().strip() or nt.NIMBUS_WORKFLOW,
            "inputs": inputs,
            "session": {"branch": self.v_branch.get().strip() or "live",
                        "path": self.v_path.get().strip() or "session.json"},
        }
        self.cloud.config["token"] = self.v_token.get().strip()
        targets = [t for t in self.cloud.targets if t.get("name") != target["name"]
                   and t.get("name") != self.pick.get()]
        targets.append(target)
        self.cloud.config["targets"] = targets
        self.cloud.config["active"] = target["name"]
        self.cloud.save()
        self.ok = True
        self.pick.configure(values=self.cloud.names())
        self.pick.set(target["name"])
        messagebox.showinfo("NimbusSeat", "Сохранено", parent=self)

    def new(self):
        self.pick.set("")
        for var in (self.v_name, self.v_repo, self.v_workflow, self.v_branch,
                    self.v_path, self.v_inputs):
            var.set("")
        self.v_workflow.set(nt.NIMBUS_WORKFLOW)
        self.v_branch.set("live")
        self.v_path.set("session.json")
        self.v_inputs.set("{}")

    def delete(self):
        name = self.pick.get()
        self.cloud.config["targets"] = [t for t in self.cloud.targets if t.get("name") != name]
        if self.cloud.config.get("active") == name:
            names = self.cloud.names()
            self.cloud.config["active"] = names[0] if names else ""
        self.cloud.save()
        self.pick.configure(values=self.cloud.names())
        if self.cloud.names():
            self.pick.set(self.cloud.names()[0])
            self.load()

    def close(self):
        self.destroy()
